fields.name: preferred_name
fields.description: Preferred or chosen name the candidate goes by, when different from their legal first name.

fields.name: company
fields.description: Candidate's current company, as entered on their profile.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Candidate's current job title, as entered on their profile.

fields.name: last_activity_at
fields.description: Timestamp of the most recent activity on any of the candidate's applications (notes, emails, stage changes, etc.), in ISO 8601.

fields.name: private
fields.description: If true, the candidate is restricted to users with `View Private Candidates` access. Defaults to `false`.

fields.name: can_email
fields.description: Whether this candidate has consented to receive email communication from your organization.

fields.name: time_zone
fields.description: Candidate's time zone as a Rails-style identifier (for example `Eastern Time (US & Canada)`).

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Candidate tag names applied to this candidate within your organization.

fields.name: linked_user_ids
fields.description: Ids of Greenhouse users linked to this candidate (employees represented by both a user record and a candidate record).

fields.name: phone_numbers
fields.description: Phone numbers on the candidate's profile. Each entry pairs the `value` with a `type` such as `mobile`, `home`, `work`, `skype`, or `other`. Ordered by type — `home`, `work`, `mobile`, `skype`, then `other` — and oldest first within a type.

fields.name: addresses
fields.description: Postal addresses on the candidate's profile. Each entry pairs the `value` with a `type` such as `home`, `work`, or `other`. Ordered oldest first.

fields.name: email_addresses
fields.description: Email addresses on the candidate's profile. Each entry pairs the `value` with a `type` such as `personal`, `work`, or `other`. Ordered by most recently updated, and oldest first among entries last updated at the same time.

fields.name: website_addresses
fields.description: Personal websites or portfolio URLs on the candidate's profile. Each entry pairs the `value` with a `type` such as `personal`, `company`, `portfolio`, `blog`, or `other`. Ordered oldest first.

fields.name: social_media_addresses
fields.description: Social media handles or URLs on the candidate's profile. Social entries are untyped — only the `value` is returned. Ordered oldest first.
